## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: Hoverfly tests cover query ID discovery, a 404 that triggers re-scrape, a...

The system SHALL ensure that hoverfly tests cover query ID discovery, a 404 that triggers re-scrape, a 429 with x-rate-limit-reset that is honoured, and a login-page response that yields the typed session_expired failure.

#### Scenario: Hoverfly tests cover query ID discovery, a 404 that triggers re-scrape, a...

WHEN `implement-x-graphql-client-with-ct0-write-back` is implemented
THEN Hoverfly tests cover query ID discovery, a 404 that triggers re-scrape, a 429 with x-rate-limit-reset that is honoured, and a login-page response that yields the typed session_expired failure.

### Requirement: A Set-Cookie header carrying a new ct0 is written back through a fake sink...

The system SHALL ensure that a Set-Cookie header carrying a new ct0 is written back through a fake sink as a single-key patch before the response is discarded.

#### Scenario: A Set-Cookie header carrying a new ct0 is written back through a fake sink...

WHEN `implement-x-graphql-client-with-ct0-write-back` is implemented
THEN A Set-Cookie header carrying a new ct0 is written back through a fake sink as a single-key patch before the response is discarded.

### Requirement: The client runs from the python:3.12-slim image and shells out to nothing

The system SHALL ensure that the client runs from the python:3.12-slim image and shells out to nothing.

#### Scenario: The client runs from the python:3.12-slim image and shells out to nothing

WHEN `implement-x-graphql-client-with-ct0-write-back` is implemented
THEN The client runs from the python:3.12-slim image and shells out to nothing.

### Requirement: No cookie or bearer value appears in logs or test output

The system SHALL ensure that no cookie or bearer value appears in logs or test output.

#### Scenario: No cookie or bearer value appears in logs or test output

WHEN `implement-x-graphql-client-with-ct0-write-back` is implemented
THEN No cookie or bearer value appears in logs or test output.
